resources.string: Shows a voice input button over text fields and starts recording when you hold the volume down key.
The model downloaded but did not pass the check
No permission to use the microphone
Could not put the text into the field
Pisar listens only while you hold the button. Nothing is sent anywhere: speech is recognized on the phone.
Turn on Giga Pisar in Accessibility
This lets Pisar notice the volume down key and put text into the field. Find “Giga Pisar” in the list of services and turn it on.
If Android says “restricted setting”: Settings → Apps → Giga Pisar → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Then turn the service on again.

HyperOS blocks accessibility for apps that were not installed from a store until “restricted settings” are allowed. Open App info → the ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings. Then add Pisar to autostart and set battery saver to “No restrictions”. Without this the service is dropped after a reboot and the volume key stops working.
EMUI drops the accessibility service for apps that were not installed from a store. Open App info → Allow restricted settings, then allow autostart in the startup manager and lift the battery limits.
One UI puts apps that were not installed from a store to sleep and the accessibility service falls off. Open App info → Allow restricted settings, then lift the battery limits in device care.
ColorOS does not keep apps that were not installed from a store in memory. Open App info → Allow restricted settings, then allow autostart and lift the battery limits.
Funtouch OS drops the accessibility service for apps that were not installed from a store. Open App info → Allow restricted settings, then allow autostart in the manager.
Android 13 and newer hides accessibility for apps that were not installed from a store until “restricted settings” are allowed. Open App info → the ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings.
Only the phone can grant these; the app cannot turn them on itself. If a button does not open the right screen, find it by hand in the phone settings.
GigaAM, 225 MB. Downloaded once, then Pisar works offline. Better over Wi-Fi.
Hold volume down in any text field and speak. Let go, and the text appears.
Hold volume down in any text field and speak. Let go, and the text appears. In a messenger, press it briefly once more and the message is sent.
Hold the floating button in any text field and speak. Let go, and the text appears.
Turn on the floating button or the volume key below, otherwise there is nothing to dictate with.
A round record button over other apps
Shows up when a text field is open
Hold volume down in a text field and speak
Outside a text field and while the phone itself is playing sound, the keys change the volume as usual.
Edits the text, but the Brain is not connected
Tidies the text up after a dictation
Shortens the text after a dictation
Translates the text after a dictation
Puts the text back as dictated
Connect the Brain to edit and translate
It takes a key of a cloud service. Tap to connect
Hold, speak, let go. A double press records without holding, a third press ends it
What text goes into the field
No Brain, everything stays on the phone
The floating button puts the text in the same way. Tap a name to read or change its instructions.
A short press after a dictation
Same as volume down: hold and speak
When volume down puts in an edited text, volume up brings back what you said

Editing and translating: press volume up briefly within 20 seconds after a dictation. It takes what you said and puts its own version into the field. One more press brings back what volume down put in. In these modes volume up does not record, and holding it by mistake does not change the volume.
Set up for each volume key on its own

Once the dictated text is in the field, press volume down briefly and Pisar taps the messenger\'s Send button. Works for 20 seconds after an insertion; the rest of the time the key lowers the volume as usual
Nothing for the Brain to fix
The field has changed, nothing was edited
A short buzz when recording starts and ends
When the take is a single sentence, insert it in lowercase and without the final period, like a line in a chat
Which key records, which one edits
Period, capital letter, “uh”, where the text goes
Tuck the button into the edge
A narrow strip stays at the edge. Hold it and speak
Up to the lock: hands-free. Sideways: cancel
The text appears at the cursor
You paste it yourself with a long press
Install it from there once, and updates will come by themselves
Giga Pisar: Russian dictation right on the phone, offline. Download: %1$s
Voice commands at the end of a phrase: “…Pisar, make it shorter”
The take goes in without its final period, however many sentences it has. Question and exclamation marks stay
Cuts hesitation sounds like «э-э», «а-а», «м-м» out of the take. Works on the phone itself, offline
A take under 12 words goes in at once and is not sent anywhere. Commands after the word “Pisar” always run
At the end Pisar adds the command itself: what is said after the word “Писарь”.
At the end Pisar adds a length target: about a fifth of the words in the take.
At the end Pisar adds the language to translate into.
Removes “um”, filler words and repeats, adds punctuation. Nothing is cut
Turns a long ramble into one clear thought without filler and repeats. Nothing important is lost
Puts a translation into the chosen language in the field. You speak your language, the other person reads theirs
With the Brain, the text goes to the chosen service over the internet. Without it, everything stays on the phone.
The service is recognized from the key, the model is picked for you.
Off. Needs a DeepSeek, OpenAI or other service key
A service with an OpenAI-style API, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1
API key, if the service needs one
The key is kept encrypted on this phone only
A key is already saved. Leave the field empty to keep it
The address must start with https:// and name a server, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1
The text goes to the server you named. The key is kept encrypted on this phone only.
Ollama address on a computer in your network, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. Ollama must accept connections from the network
Leave empty and a model is picked from the server list automatically
Could not fetch the model list from the server, type the model name manually
Enter the Ollama address with http:// or https://. Plain http is allowed only for local network addresses
Text is sent to your computer. Unencrypted http is allowed only for Ollama on your local network; do not expose the Ollama port to the internet.
Paste an API key of a service below, DeepSeek for example. The key is kept encrypted on this phone only.
The field has changed. The original text is in the clipboard
The original text is in the clipboard
Or update from the file, as before
Pisar is on Google Play now. Tap to install it from there: your settings and the model stay, and updates will come by themselves
Pisar is on Google Play now. Install it from there once: your settings and the model stay, and updates will come by themselves
Let Pisar install apps: needed once. Then come back here.
the file came down damaged, try again
Direct insertion only. Where a field doesn\'t take it, Pisar offers to copy the text instead
This field doesn\'t take text directly
The floating button does not appear in the apps you tick. The volume key works there as usual.
The phone cannot reach the server. Check the internet: Wi-Fi may be connected without access. If Private DNS is on, set it to Automatic or try mobile data.
